title: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2000
SINDH PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE I OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th March, 2000]
No. S.LEGIS.1(1)/2000/588, dated
15-3-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Public Service
Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act XI of 1999

ORDINANCE I OF 2000
SINDH PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE I OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th March, 2000]
No. S.LEGIS.1(1)/2000/588, dated
15-3-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 5 of
Sindh Act XI of 1999.--In the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989, in
section 5, in subsection (2), after the second proviso, the following new
proviso shall be added:--
"Provided further that the
Government may, in an individual case and in the public interest, allow such
employment on such terms and conditions as may be prescribed, in the case of a
Member who had ceased to hold office either as a result of completing the term
of office or had resigned."
